scope: Canonical data, organizations, valuations/provenance, documents, reference data, benchmarks/FX, analytics and API authority. No production/DB/task-queue mutation.

findings.current_state: fond_investissements is the live fund authority. It contains identity, ISIN, country/region, periodicity, currency, manager link, categories, fees, investment policy, benchmark mapping and FundAfrica reference fields.
evidence: src/models/fond.js defines fond_investissements.
src/services/allocation/data/provider.js explicitly declares fund_master_table='fond_investissements' and active_only=true.
app.js and current routes consume the same table.
verified_gaps: No canonical SubFund/ShareClass entity was found in current code search.
Fund/share-class identity ambiguities are known historically, especially Nigeria.
Several categorical/reference values still live as strings on the fund row.
required_preflight: Measure live schema and duplicate/identity cases before any new table.
Map every fund identity consumer in API/frontend/importers.
Reconcile ISIN/name/class-share ambiguities per country.
compatible_future_actions: Preserve fond_investissements as compatibility authority.
Add child/alias/history structures only if live evidence proves they are necessary.
Introduce stable IDs/relationships additively and migrate consumers incrementally.
do_not: Do not rename/drop fond_investissements.
Do not infer ShareClass/SubFund solely from names.
Do not create a second Fund Master.

evidence: src/models/societe.js defines societes.
20260514000001-add-societe-id-fk.js added societe_id columns and populated them by name match.
src/db/sequelize.js defines Fond<->Societe association.
verified_gaps: The migration name says FK but only columns/indexes are added; no database FK constraint is created.
documents.societe_id and personnel_sgs.societe_id have no Sequelize association in src/db/sequelize.js.
Legacy string joins by societe_gestion/societe remain active in routes.
required_preflight: Measure null/orphan/duplicate societe_id counts live.
Inventory routes still joining by manager name.
Check whether actual DB FK constraints exist independently of migration naming.
compatible_future_actions: Prefer societe_id for canonical joins while retaining legacy text during migration.
Add ORM associations for documents/personnel only after consumer/test audit.
Introduce aliases/manager-history additively if required.
do_not: Do not delete societe_gestion/societe string fields before all consumers migrate.
Do not add hard FK constraints before orphan audit and rollback plan.

findings.current_state: valorisations is the live time-series authority for NAV-like values, adjusted values, currencies, dividends, benchmarks and AUM-related fields.
evidence: src/models/vl.js defines core valorisations fields.
Production diagnostics and allocation both consume valorisations.
2026_08_nigeria_additive_measures.sql adds explicit measurement/provenance columns.
verified_gaps: src/models/vl.js does not expose additive live-schema fields net_assets_*, unit_price_*, bid_price_*, offer_price_*, price_type, currency_code, sec_document_id, source_url, report_date, data_quality, correction_batch.
ORM/schema parity is therefore incomplete at source level.
Legacy core columns are allowNull:false in Sequelize while production history contains heterogeneous legacy semantics.
required_preflight: Read live information_schema for all valorisations columns/types/nullability.
Inventory all ORM and raw-SQL writers before changing the model.
Verify whether sequelize sync is disabled in production and keep it disabled for audit.
compatible_future_actions: Add missing model fields only as nullable mirrors after live schema confirmation.
Keep value compatibility but expose explicit measurement type/currency/provenance to new code.
Create writer contract tests before broadening strict enforcement.
do_not: Do not change legacy column types/nullability from code without migration.
Do not reinterpret value as Unit Price when price_type proves BID/OFFER.
Do not enable sync alter as a shortcut.

findings.current_state: vl_contract.js provides a valuable write contract for currency, price type, quality, batch and official source provenance, currently strongest for Nigeria.
evidence: src/lib/vl_contract.js explicitly protects currency/type/provenance and supports warn/strict.
Nigeria migrations/importers persist source_url, sec_document_id, report_date, data_quality and correction_batch.
docs/12-optional/DATA_LINEAGE.md defines source→ingestion→transformation→storage→calculation→API→display/export.
verified_gaps: Provenance vocabulary is partly Nigeria-specific (sec_document_id).
Fine-grained document/page/sheet/row/cell/API-path lineage is not platform-wide.
Most non-Nigeria writers historically did not populate the qualification contract.
required_preflight: Inventory every current valorisations writer and which provenance fields it supplies.
Classify source types by country/file/API/manual correction.
Measure UNQUALIFIED/null provenance by pipeline without mutating data.
compatible_future_actions: Define a generic source observation/artifact identifier while retaining SEC-specific fields for compatibility.
Adopt the contract writer-by-writer in warn mode before strict mode.
Propagate quality/provenance into view models where useful.
do_not: Do not retroactively fabricate provenance.
Do not make strict mode global before every active writer is compatible.
Do not overwrite official raw artifacts.

findings.current_state: documents is an active store linked to funds and carrying societe_id plus legacy manager/fund strings and file metadata.
evidence: src/models/document.js defines documents.
src/db/sequelize.js defines Fond<->Document.
Routes expose document upload/listing surfaces.
verified_gaps: No canonical document type taxonomy, official source URL, hash/checksum, visa/issuer verification fields are visible in the model.
No Societe<->Document ORM association despite societe_id.
Fine-grained lineage from data observation to source document is not generalized.
required_preflight: Inventory document rows/types/storage paths and duplicate semantics live.
Map all upload/download consumers and access controls.
Identify existing official-document metadata outside this model before adding fields.
compatible_future_actions: Extend the existing documents authority additively with verified metadata as needed.
Use stable document IDs/hashes and explicit fund/manager relationships.
Reference canonical documents from DDQ/RFP rather than copying files.
do_not: Do not create a second document repository for Institutional.
Do not guess official URLs/types from filenames.
Do not break existing file paths.

findings.current_state: Five additive reference tables exist by design: ref_asset_classes, ref_geo_zones, ref_categories_fundafrica, ref_indices_fundafrica, ref_index_sources; apigestionreferentiel exposes read APIs.
evidence: scripts/seed/seed_referentiel_fundafrica.js creates and seeds the five tables.
src/routes/apigestionreferentiel.js reads them and handles ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE.
fond_investissements stores mapped FundAfrica category/index fields.
verified_gaps: No src/db/migrations entry was found for these five CREATE TABLE statements.
Table creation and seed data are coupled in one operational script.
Sequelize models for these reference tables are not present; routes use raw SQL.
required_preflight: Verify live table existence/count/schema before creating any migration.
Compare live schema byte-for-byte/column-for-column with seed DDL.
Determine whether raw-SQL read access is intentionally preferred.
compatible_future_actions: Create idempotent canonical migrations representing the already-existing schema only after live verification.
Refactor seed to seed-only after migration authority exists.
Keep current routes backward-compatible.
do_not: Do not recreate/drop populated ref tables.
Do not run seed --execute as a schema migration substitute during production maintenance.
Do not create duplicate reference tables.

findings.current_state: indice_references and devisedechanges are live series authorities; fund rows also hold declared benchmark/reference mapping and FundAfrica analytical mappings.
evidence: src/models/indice.js defines indice_references.
src/models/devisedechanges.js defines FX table.
Production shows live MASI/Tunindex/BRVM/NSE series and country benchmark coverage.
FundAfrica ref_indices_fundafrica is a separate analytical/reference mapping layer.

Manual uploadsfileindice has commented indice_references persistence while writing indRef on VL.
CEMAC has 0% benchmark coverage and Morocco recent historical coverage remains partial.
required_preflight: Map every writer/reader of indice_references, indRef*, indice_benchmark, indice and indice_fundafrica*.
Classify each field as declared benchmark, analytical benchmark, series ID or denormalized cached value.
Verify FX nearest-date/no-lookahead semantics by consumer.
compatible_future_actions: Document a three-layer benchmark contract without changing data first.
Use one canonical index series authority and explicit mappings.
Keep denormalized indRef fields only as compatibility/cache with reproducible propagation.
do_not: Do not restore commented writes blindly.
Do not use one equity index as benchmark for every fund category.
Do not use future FX rates for historical dates.

evidence: apigestionfonds/apigestionratios/apigestionperformance contain extensive legacy calculations.
src/routes/analytics.js requires ClickHouse and contains its own risk calculations.

Performance/risk logic is duplicated across modules.
Production C2/C3/C8 proves derived tables can be stale/wrong despite plausible UI values.
required_preflight: Inventory each metric implementation and current runtime consumer.
Build reference outputs on certified funds/dates.
Classify ClickHouse routes ACTIVE/OPTIONAL/LEGACY at current runtime.
compatible_future_actions: Converge metric contracts incrementally around shared versioned functions.
Keep output compatibility while replacing duplicate internal implementations.
Use quality/data-cutoff metadata in every new analytics response.
do_not: Do not activate ClickHouse merely because routes exist.
Do not change financial conventions without before/after fixtures.
Do not delete legacy calculations before all consumers migrate.

src/services/allocation/engine/adapter.js rejects non-PASS quality.

Naming can imply stronger certification than actually present.
C3/C7/C8 remain live production failures.
required_preflight: Do not touch AF-TASK-017 claimed constraint surfaces.
Resolve AF-OPS-007/008/009 or define machine-readable fund/date eligibility first.
Decide whether the bridge belongs to AF-TASK-018, AF-TASK-020 or an extension of AF-TASK-014/015 after queue claim release.

Load certified quality metadata only when semantics are stable.
